switcher.removeBody: Remove this multisig from this device? Its funds are not affected — add it again any time with its address.
switcher.createAccountNote: A new account, kept by a passkey on this device.
switcher.signInNote: An account you already have, with its passkey.
switcher.createMultisigNote: An account several members share: transfers need enough of their approvals.
switcher.addMultisigNote: By its address, or import your Safes from Safe{Wallet}.
switcher.lastMember: It is this device’s only member of {{names}}: without it, those can only be read here, not approved.

panel.title: Needs {{m}} of {{n}} members
panel.readOnly: None of its members is on this device. Members approve with their own wallets: open a transaction and choose “Approve with another wallet”.
panel.stale: Couldn't refresh — showing the last known state.
panel.notShared: Not shared yet: other members can add it once it is recorded. Vela keeps trying.
panel.lastKnown: Last known list, from {{time}} — checking for changes.
panel.checking: Checking for transactions waiting for approval…
panel.historyUnreadable: Couldn't read this multisig's history on {{network}}: transactions executed elsewhere may be missing here.
panel.nonMembersWarning: No member of this multisig has approved this. Anyone can post to the mailbox — don't approve something you don't recognise.

status.nobodyPays: no account on this device can pay the network fee
status.conflict: Only one of these can run

change.caution: This changes who controls this multisig on {{network}}. Approve only if every member expects it.
change.doesNotFit: This doesn’t fit the members it has on {{network}} now: executing it would fail.

token.lookalike: Not the real {{symbol}} — a different contract uses this name

proposal.title: Multisig transaction
proposal.feeNote: The network fee is paid by the executing member's account.
proposal.inviteHint: Send this link to the members who still need to approve. It opens this transaction in Vela, where they check it and approve.
proposal.rejectHint: Rejecting proposes a cancellation at the same number; it needs {{threshold}} approvals too, and whichever is executed first wins.
proposal.rejectHint_one: Rejecting proposes a cancellation at the same number; it needs {{count}} approval too, and whichever is executed first wins.
proposal.rejectHint_other: Rejecting proposes a cancellation at the same number; it needs {{count}} approvals too, and whichever is executed first wins.
proposal.cancelPending: A cancellation of this transaction is waiting for approval.
proposal.doneNote: This transaction number is used: the transaction was executed or cancelled.
proposal.queuedNote: It can run once transaction #{{nonce}} is executed or cancelled.
proposal.notMember: Only members can approve, and none is signed in on this device.
proposal.noExpiry: Approvals don't expire: they count until the transaction is executed or cancelled.
proposal.notFound: This transaction hasn't been shared with the members yet.
proposal.notHere: This transaction belongs to a multisig that isn't shown here. Open its link to read it.
proposal.cannotPay: {{name}} doesn't hold enough {{symbol}} for the network fee: about {{fee}} is needed, {{balance}} is there. Add some, or let another member execute.
proposal.notLanded: It hasn't reached the network after three minutes. If it doesn't show as executed soon, try again.
proposal.mailboxDown: Couldn't read this multisig's waiting transactions, so nothing was proposed. Try again in a moment.
proposal.notSent: The network didn't take it, so nothing was sent. Try again.
proposal.siteWaits: {{host}} gets the transaction once it is executed. If that takes longer than 5 minutes, or you close this, the site is told it was proposed and is waiting for approvals; it stays in Activity.
proposal.siteTold: {{host}} was told it was proposed and is waiting for approvals; it won’t get the transaction hash. The transaction stays in Activity, and the members can still execute it.
proposal.changesMembers: Call #{{index}} changes this multisig itself: {{change}}. Approve only if every member expects it.
proposal.siteFollows: {{host}} was given this transaction’s id and follows it until the members execute or reject it. It stays in Activity.
proposal.voidedNote: Replaced by a cancellation at #{{nonce}}: this transaction can never run.
proposal.voidedByOther: Replaced by another transaction at #{{nonce}}: this one can never run.
proposal.notInMailbox: This transaction isn’t in this multisig’s mailbox. Ask whoever sent the link to check it.
proposal.badLink: This link to a multisig transaction is incomplete or damaged. Ask for it again.
proposal.previewNote: No account on this device is a member of this multisig. Opening this link didn't add it or switch accounts.
proposal.watching: On this device: it's in your accounts list. The account shown hasn't changed.
proposal.renameRuns: This runs on {{network}}, where its shared name is kept: only the multisig itself can change it there.
proposal.renameUndeployed: The multisig isn’t deployed on {{network}}, so this can’t be executed there: only the deployed multisig can change its shared name, and this change never deploys it.
proposal.startsOriginal: This network starts with the original members
proposal.startsOriginalNote: Executing this deploys the multisig here with the members it was created with — {{m}} of {{n}} approve — not the members it has now on {{networks}}.
proposal.notCounted: Not counted — not a member on {{network}} now: {{names}}
proposal.missingNetworkNamed: On {{name}} (chain {{chainId}}) — a network this device doesn’t have
proposal.missingNetwork: On chain {{chainId}} — a network this device doesn’t have
proposal.missingNetworkBody: A member proposed this on a network this device doesn’t have. Add the network to read and approve it here; until then it isn’t checked or counted.
proposal.outboxBusy: The multisig service is busy — sending again in {{seconds}} s.
proposal.outboxAway: Couldn’t reach the multisig service — sending again in {{seconds}} s.
proposal.outboxNotSent: Not sent yet: the multisig service didn’t take it. It’s kept on this device, and other members can’t see it until it’s sent.
proposal.wouldFail: This would fail if executed now: {{reason}}.
proposal.whyShort: the multisig holds {{have}}, and this needs {{need}}
proposal.whyRevertsPlain: it reverts when it runs, and the network gives no reason
proposal.unpricedReason: the network fee couldn’t be worked out — try again in a moment
proposal.uncheckedReason: it couldn’t be checked whether it would run — try again in a moment
proposal.feeChecking: Checking that it would run, and the network fee…
proposal.feeUnpriced: Couldn’t work out the network fee right now.
proposal.feeUnchecked: Couldn’t check whether it would run — you can still approve; Execute checks again.
proposal.feeUncheckedHeld: Couldn’t check whether it would run — Execute checks again.
proposal.feeSigning: Signing at this fee — it stays fixed until you confirm or cancel.
proposal.feeRose: The network fee went up to ≈ {{fee}} since you pressed; nothing was signed. Press again to pay {{fee}}.
proposal.setupMember: activating {{name}}’s account — the multisig checks their approval through it
proposal.setupExecutor: activating {{name}}’s account, which pays the fee
proposal.cantPayOther: {{name}} can’t pay the network fee — {{other}} can execute it.
proposal.approvesInVela: Approves in Vela on their own device: {{names}}. Send them this link.
proposal.eitherWay: Not known yet how they approve: {{names}}. They can approve in Vela with this link, or with their own wallet using the outside-wallet link.
proposal.contractMembers: {{names}}: a smart contract account approves from its own app (e.g. another Safe). Vela can't collect those approvals yet.
proposal.noOutsideSigner: no member is on this device, and every member approves in Vela on their own device — ask one of them to propose it
proposal.lostRace: Another member executed this first. Nothing was sent from your account.
proposal.lostRacePaid: Another member executed this first. Your account's attempt reached the network too and paid its network fee.
proposal.replacedFirst: Another transaction at #{{nonce}} ran first, so this one can never run. Nothing was sent from your account.
proposal.replacedFirstPaid: Another transaction at #{{nonce}} ran first, so this one can never run. Your account's attempt reached the network and paid its network fee.
proposal.execFailed: It reached the network but didn't execute: its call failed. The network fee was paid.
proposal.cantCheck: Can't reach {{network}} — can't check this transaction right now.
proposal.cantCheckUsed: This transaction's number is used, but {{network}} can't be read right now to say whether it was executed or replaced.
proposal.conflict: Only one of the transactions waiting at #{{nonce}} can run: the first one executed replaces the others.
proposal.queuedNoteMany: It can run once transactions {{nonces}} are executed or cancelled.

reason.passkeyClosed: The passkey prompt was closed, so nothing was signed. If this device has no passkey for this account, use the device that has it.
reason.passkeyTimedOut: The passkey prompt timed out, so nothing was signed. Try again when you're ready.
reason.passkeyMissing: This device has no passkey for this account, so nothing was signed. Use the device that has it.
reason.passkeyFailed: The passkey's signature didn't check out for this account, so nothing was signed or sent.
reason.serviceKept: The multisig service didn't answer. What you signed is kept on this device and sent again on its own.
reason.serviceRefused: The multisig service refused it, so it wasn't saved. Nothing was sent.
reason.offline: You're offline, so nothing was sent. Try again once you're back online.
reason.chainUnreachable: Can't reach {{network}} right now, so nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
reason.unknown: Something went wrong, so nothing was sent. Try again.

proposal.countedThen: {{approved}} of {{threshold}} approvals counted when it was executed
proposal.approvalsSigned: These members approved it. Which approvals counted when it was executed isn’t recorded on this device.
proposal.outboxSending: Sending your approval to the other members…

unread.chain: Couldn't reach {{network}} to read this multisig, so nothing was proposed. Try again in a moment.
unread.both: Couldn't reach {{network}} or the multisig service, so nothing was proposed. Check your connection and try again.
unread.linkChain: Couldn't reach {{network}} to open this transaction.
unread.linkService: Couldn't reach the multisig service to find this transaction.
unread.linkBoth: Couldn't reach {{network}} or the multisig service to open this transaction. Check your connection.

send.invalidChecksum: The capital letters in this address don't match its checksum — a typo, or a copy that was altered. Check it and copy it again.

create.title: New multisig
create.intro: A shared account: funds move only when enough members approve.
create.order: Each member approves with their own device or wallet.
create.thresholdAll: Every member must approve. If one of them loses access, the funds can never move again.
create.thresholdOne: Any single member can move the funds alone.
create.thresholdSpare_one: Up to {{count}} member can lose access and the funds still move.
create.thresholdSpare_other: Up to {{count}} members can lose access and the funds still move.
create.sameEverywhere: The same address on every network. Nothing is deployed until its first transfer out.
create.creator: Confirmed by
create.needLocal: At least one member must be an account on this device.
create.duplicate: This member is already in the list.
create.notMember: This address can't be a member.
create.createdBody: Send the other members the invite link — it adds the multisig in Vela with its network and their names.
create.createdBodySolo: It has one member for now, and that member approves alone. Add members any time in Settings; to use it on another device, open its invite link there.
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Every member sees this name. It's saved with the multisig; changing it later takes the members' approval.
create.nameInvalid: Use a shorter name, without control or invisible characters or spaces at either end.
create.noSafeNetworks: None of your networks has the Safe contracts a multisig needs. Add one that does in Settings → Networks.
create.nameTooLong: Too long: {{bytes}} of {{limit}} bytes. Use a shorter name.
create.nameNeeded: Give it a name — every member sees it.
create.ensResolved: {{name}} points to this address — check it before you add it:
create.ensNotFound: {{name}} doesn't point to an address. Check the name, or enter the address.
create.ensUnavailable: Couldn't look up {{name}} on Ethereum right now. Try again, or enter the address.
create.ensUnsupported: This name has characters Vela can't look up safely. Enter the member's address instead.
create.solo: One member makes a 1 of 1 multisig: that member alone can move its funds, like an account of its own. You can add members later — each change is one of its transactions.
create.networkHint: Where you’ll use it first. You can use it on your other networks too.
create.networkNeeded: Choose the network it will be used on first.
create.savedSharing: Saved on this device · sharing with the members…
create.savedLater: Saved on this device. The multisig service can't be reached right now; Vela shares it with the members as soon as it can.
create.shared: Shared: the other members can add it now.
create.sharedSolo: Shared: it can be added on another device by its address.
create.refused: Saved on this device, but the multisig service didn't record it ({{reason}}). Share it again from Settings.
create.firstRunInviteNote: A link or a code that adds it in Vela, with its network and members.
create.firstRunCost: Its first transfer out also sets it up on {{network}}: a one-time network fee, paid with that transfer and shown before it's executed.
create.otherSpace: Also on this device, in {{space}}: {{networks}}. To create the multisig on one of them, switch to {{space}} first.
create.draftKept: Picked up where you left off.
create.closeBody: What you've entered is kept on this device: open New multisig again to pick up where you left off.

invite.body: Members scan the code or open the link: it adds the multisig in Vela with its network and the members' names.
invite.outsideHint: Members who use another wallet, not Vela, don't need to add it: when a transaction needs their approval, send them its link and they approve it with their own wallet.

presence.waitingPayer_one: {{count}} waiting for a member who can pay
presence.waitingPayer_other: {{count}} waiting for a member who can pay
presence.ruleLastKnown: Last known — read again when you open it

add.title: Add a multisig
add.intro: Enter the multisig's address. Vela finds its setup and checks that it gives this address and contains nothing that grants control to anyone outside its members.
add.notFound: No multisig with this address is known yet. If it was just created, try again in a minute.
add.unavailable: Couldn't reach the service. Try again.
add.unsupported: This Safe's version isn't supported yet.
add.notMultisig: This address isn't a multisig Vela can read.
add.chooseNetwork: Nothing says which network this multisig is used on yet. Choose its network, then tap Add.
add.unchecked: No record of this address yet, and some networks didn't answer in time — so Vela can't say whether it's a multisig. Try again.
add.busy: {{network}}'s nodes are busy — they're limiting how often Vela can ask — so Vela couldn't check this multisig yet. Nothing was added. Try again in a moment.
add.badInvite: This invite link is damaged — part of it is missing or was changed on the way. Ask for the link again, or enter the multisig's address.
add.badChecksum: This invite's address doesn't match its checksum — ask for a new link.
add.networkMissing: It's used on {{network}}, which this device doesn't have yet. Add the network; the invite opens again in your wallet once it's there.
add.invitedMembers: Members, as the invite names them:
add.labelsNote: Names are labels from whoever sent the invite. Who can approve is read from the network itself.
add.badLink: This invite link is incomplete or damaged. Ask for it again, or enter the multisig's address.

authority.refusedBody: Its setup could give control of its funds to someone other than its members, so Vela won't deploy it or sign for it.
authority.unverified: Vela couldn't check the Safe contracts on {{network}} yet, so it can't tell who would control this multisig there. Try again in a moment.
authority.wrongAddress: Its setup doesn't make this address.
authority.notSetup: Its setup isn't a plain Safe setup that Vela can read in full.
authority.badMembers: Its members or approval rule aren't valid, so it could never be deployed.
authority.unknownFactory: It's deployed through a contract that isn't a Safe factory Vela knows: {{address}}
authority.unknownSingleton: It runs on a contract that isn't a Safe version Vela supports: {{address}}
authority.module: Its setup turns on a module that can move funds without its members: {{address}}
authority.setupCode: Its setup runs code at {{address}}, which can give control to anyone.
authority.handler: Its setup installs a contract that answers calls it doesn't know, and it isn't Safe's: {{address}}
authority.payment: Its setup pays out of the multisig to {{address}} when it's deployed.
authority.missingCode: On {{network}}, there's no Safe contract at {{address}}.
authority.wrongCode: On {{network}}, the contract at {{address}} isn't Safe's own code.
authority.riskTitle: Something besides its members can act for this multisig
authority.riskBody: Whoever controls these can move its funds or block it, whatever its members approve. Add it only if you know exactly why it has them.
authority.riskModule: On {{network}}, this multisig has a module that can move funds without its members: {{address}}
authority.riskGuard: On {{network}}, this multisig has a check that can block or change its transactions: {{address}}
authority.riskHandler: On {{network}}, the contract that answers calls this multisig doesn't know isn't Safe's: {{address}}
authority.riskSingleton: On {{network}}, this multisig runs code that isn't a Safe version Vela knows: {{address}}
authority.deployRefused: Vela won't deploy this multisig on {{network}}:
authority.deployUnverified: Vela couldn't check the Safe contracts on {{network}}, so it won't deploy this multisig there yet. Try again in a moment.
authority.refusedOn: Read-only on {{network}}: Vela won't deploy it or sign for it there.
authority.signRiskBody: On {{network}}, something besides its members can act for this multisig. Whoever controls it can move its funds or block it, whatever you sign. Sign only if you know exactly why it has it.
authority.signUnchecked: Vela couldn't check who can act for this multisig on {{network}}, so it won't sign there yet. Try again in a moment.
authority.signDisagreed: Two independent nodes on {{network}} gave different answers about who can act for this multisig, so Vela won't sign there. Add your own node in Settings to check with one you trust, or try again later.
authority.ownerNotBound: On {{network}}, member {{address}} is a contract nothing ties to its own creation there — whoever can deploy at that address would hold its vote.

external.pageTitle: Approve with your wallet for Vela
external.noWallet: Open this page where your wallet is
external.noWalletBody: This page needs a wallet extension (MetaMask, Rabby, …) or a wallet app's built-in browser. Copy the link into it, or scan Vela's code with the wallet app.
external.chooseWallet: Choose the wallet to sign with
external.askConnect: Vela asks to use this wallet to approve multisig transactions.
external.askNote: Continue only if you started this in Vela just now. Nothing is signed unless your wallet asks you.
external.keepOpen: Connected. Keep this page open: Vela's requests appear here first, then in your wallet.
external.noSession: Open this page from the link Vela shows when a member signs with another wallet.
external.scanBody: Open this link in the browser that holds a member's wallet (MetaMask, Rabby, …), or scan the code with the wallet app.
external.resumeBody: Open Vela's connect page again in the browser where {{wallet}} signed before: it is paired with this device.
external.connecting: Approve the connection on the wallet page.
external.wrongAccount: The wallet holds {{account}}, which isn't a member here. Switch to a member's account in the wallet.
external.badSignature: That signature isn't a member's for this transaction.
external.pageAway: The wallet page closed. Open it again where your wallet is: the request is still waiting.
external.connectDeclined: The connection was declined on the wallet page. Try again to ask once more.
external.declinedHere: You declined. Vela has been told; you can close this page.
external.otherChain: The wallet stayed on another network. Switch it to {{chain}} and try again.
external.expectedMember: Vela asked for a member of the multisig: {{accounts}}.
external.notExpectedMember: {{account}} isn't a member Vela asked for, so this page won't connect it or sign with it. In your wallet, switch to {{accounts}}; this page carries on once you do.
external.queuedTx: Waits for transaction {{nonce}} to run first
external.refusedKind: Vela doesn't sign this kind of transaction: {{reason}}
external.hashesNote: A hardware wallet shows these hashes. If any of them differs, don't sign.
external.notSafeTx: This request isn't a multisig transaction this page can read. Decline it.
external.stillWaiting: Still waiting for {{wallet}} — check the wallet window. It may be behind this one.
external.stoppedWaiting: Stopped waiting. If the wallet still shows the request, dismiss it there, then try again.
external.signedClose: Signed ✓ — you can close this page.
external.signedHashForm: Signed as the transaction's hash (eth_sign form).
external.withdrawnInWallet: Vela withdrew a request your wallet may still show. Dismiss it there.
external.ethSignOffer: You can sign the transaction's hash instead (Safe's eth_sign form). Your wallet then shows only the hash: check that it is {{hash}}.
external.approveOnChainOffer: Or approve on chain: your wallet sends a transaction to the multisig and pays its fee.
external.velaNotConnected: Vela's side isn't connected. It connects once the request is open in Vela again; keep this page open.
external.relayFailed: Can't connect to the signing relay ({{reason}}).
external.relayRetrying: Can't connect to the signing relay ({{reason}}) — retrying in {{seconds}} s.
external.relayUnreachable: Can't reach the signing relay ({{reason}}) — retrying…
external.relayNoToken: this device couldn't get a pass for it
external.velaRelayFailed: Vela can't reach the signing relay ({{reason}}).
external.velaRelayRetrying: Vela can't reach the signing relay ({{reason}}) — retrying in {{seconds}} s.
external.velaRelayUnreachable: Vela can't reach the signing relay ({{reason}}) — retrying…
external.missingTx: This transaction isn't in the shared queue yet. If Vela has it open, keep this page open.
external.mismatchTx: The shared queue's copy doesn't match this link's transaction, so this page won't sign it.
external.txUnavailable: Can't read the transaction: {{what}} didn't answer.
external.doneTx: Its number is used: it was executed or cancelled.
external.doneCancelled: This transaction was cancelled: another transaction at its number ran, so it can never run.
external.approvedClose: Approved ✓ — you can close this page.
external.rejectedHere: Rejection proposed. It needs as many approvals as the transaction; the other members see it in Vela.
external.mailboxBusy: The shared queue is busy — sending again in {{seconds}} s.
external.sendingMailbox: Sending your approval to the other members…
external.notSent: Your approval is signed but didn't reach the shared queue. Nothing needs signing again.
external.notOwnerHere: {{account}} isn't a member of this multisig on {{network}}. Switch to a member's account in your wallet.
external.executeFee: Network fee ≈ {{fee}}, paid by your wallet ({{account}}).
external.executeFeeUnknown: Your wallet pays the network fee and shows it before you confirm.
external.executeSteps: The multisig is set up on {{network}} first: your wallet asks you to confirm each transaction.
external.mailboxRefused: The shared queue didn't take it: {{reason}}
external.walletUnauthorized: Connect this account in your wallet first, then try again.
external.walletGone: {{wallet}} disconnected. Reconnect it and try again.
external.linkLater: The link works later too, with this sheet closed: the member can review and approve from it alone.
external.outsideLinkTitle: For a member with another wallet
external.outsideLinkHint: They open this link where their wallet is (MetaMask, Rabby, a wallet app), review the transaction and sign there — no Vela account needed.
external.mailboxNoEthSign: The shared queue doesn't take the hash form yet, so the other members wouldn't see this approval. Approve on chain instead, or with a wallet that signs typed data.
external.enoughApprovals: It already has enough approvals — nothing to sign.
external.executeNeedsGas: Your wallet needs ≈ {{fee}} for the network fee and holds {{balance}}. Add some to execute, or let another member execute it.
external.executeNoGas: Your wallet holds no {{symbol}} for the network fee. Add some to execute, or let another member execute it.
external.refusedSetupUnchecked: The multisig service couldn't check this multisig's setup right now — try again.
external.refusedSetup: The multisig service couldn't match this multisig's setup, so it didn't take it.
external.refusedSignature: The multisig service didn't take this signature as a member's approval.
external.refusedFull: The multisig service holds as many waiting transactions for this multisig as it can. Try again once some are executed or rejected.
external.refusedTransaction: The multisig service doesn't take this kind of transaction.
external.refusedOther: The multisig service didn't take it — try again in a moment.
external.keptSigned: What you signed is kept on this page and sent again — nothing is signed twice.
external.nameFromRecord: Its name as saved with its record — the address is what you sign for
external.linkDamaged: This link is damaged — ask for a new one.
external.executeConfirms: Your wallet will ask you to confirm {{total}} transactions, one after another.
external.executeFeeMax: Network fee ≈ {{fee}}, at most {{max}}, paid by your wallet ({{account}}).

import.body: Export your Safes from Safe{Wallet} (Settings → Data → Export) and choose the file. It is read on this device only.
import.notExport: This file isn't a Safe{Wallet} export.
import.empty: There are no Safes in this file.
import.notDeployed: Not deployed on any of its networks, and the file doesn't hold its setup.
import.kindsBody: A Vela account approves in Vela with its passkey; another wallet signs with that wallet. Vela fills in what it can tell. This only decides what Vela offers them — who can approve is set by the Safe.

settings.backupTitle: Back up its setup on Ethereum
settings.backupNote: Its setup is kept on Ethereum as well, so the multisig can be found and deployed from there. An account on this device pays the fee.
settings.renameNote: Members, and anyone who looks this multisig up, see this name. Renaming it is one of its transactions on {{network}}, where its record is kept: members approve it like any other.
settings.renameUnavailable: Its record isn't on a network this wallet has, so it can't be renamed from here.
settings.shareAgainNote: The multisig service doesn't have its setup, so other members can't add it by its address yet. Sharing it takes one passkey confirmation.
settings.renameNotDeployed: Only the multisig itself can change its shared name, on {{network}}, and it isn’t deployed there.
settings.originalNote: The members it was created with. A network it isn’t deployed on starts with these.
settings.sameAsOriginal: The same as the original members.
settings.undeployedOn: Not deployed on {{network}} yet: it will start there with the original members.
settings.renameNotRecorded: It can be renamed once its record is saved with the multisig service.
settings.renamePending: It can be renamed once its record lands on {{network}}. That can take a while — nothing is lost meanwhile.

service.unreachableNote: Multisig service unreachable — waiting transactions can't be loaded; retrying.
service.busyNote: Multisig service busy — waiting transactions will load shortly; retrying.
service.chainUnreachable: Can't reach {{network}} — its waiting transactions can't be checked right now.

members.title: Change members
members.lostPasskey: Lost a passkey? Replace that member: the others approve, and the funds stay where they are.
members.nameUnavailable: Couldn't look up {{name}} right now. Try again, or enter the address.
members.suggestions: On this device and in your contacts
members.nameNote: The name stays on this device. Other members see the address.
members.kindKnown: Vela found a Vela account at this address. It approves in Vela, with its passkey.
members.kindLikely: No Vela account found at this address — likely another wallet. Tap Other wallet to confirm; left as it is, they'll be offered both ways to approve.
members.kindAsk: Vela can't tell from the address. Choose one — or leave it, and they'll be offered both ways to approve.
members.kindContractNote: Approves from its own app (e.g. another Safe). Vela can't collect its approval yet.
members.replaceIntro: Put {{name}}'s new account in their place, for example after a lost passkey. The other members approve it; nothing else changes.
members.removeIntro: {{name}} will no longer approve transactions or move funds.
members.perNetwork: One proposal on each network it's deployed on:
members.noneDeployed: Members can be changed on a network once the multisig is deployed there. Its first transfer out on a network deploys it.
members.recovery: Lost a passkey? That's fine: if one of the {{n}} members loses theirs, {{m}} of the others approve putting their new account in its place (Settings → Replace). The address and the funds stay the same.
members.recoveryAll: Every member must approve, so a member who loses their passkey can't be replaced. Lower the approvals needed while everyone still can.

refuse.noOne: This address can't be a member.
refuse.theMultisig: The multisig can't be its own member.
refuse.lastMember: The last member can't be removed.
refuse.thresholdZero: At least one approval is needed.
refuse.belowThreshold: That would leave {{owners}} members while {{threshold}} must approve. Lower the approvals needed, or replace the member instead.
refuse.tooMany: A multisig can have at most {{max}} members.
refuse.changeWaiting: Another member change is waiting there. Execute or reject it first.

review.stateTitle: This changes who controls this multisig
review.stateBody: Running it on {{network}} would change what decides who controls the multisig, and the transaction doesn't say so. Vela won't sign it. Don't sign it anywhere else either.
review.writeSingleton: Replaces the code the multisig runs: {{before}} → {{after}}
review.writeModuleOn: Enables a module that can move funds without the members: {{address}}
review.writeGuard: Sets a check that can block or change its transactions: {{after}}
review.writeModuleGuard: Sets a check on what its modules do: {{after}}
review.writeHandler: Changes the contract that answers calls it doesn't know to {{after}}
review.writeOwnerEntry: Lets {{address}} sign without listing it as a member
review.writeThreshold: Changes the approvals needed from {{before}} to {{after}}
review.stateUnchanged: Checked on {{network}}: running it changes nothing about who controls the multisig.
review.stateDeclared: Checked on {{network}}: it changes the members exactly as it says, and nothing else.
review.stateUnread: Couldn't check on {{network}} what running it changes in the multisig. Only Vela's reading of the transaction stands.
review.sourceTrace: Every write to the multisig's storage, traced.
review.sourceProbe: What it runs, what can act for it or check its transactions, its members and its rule — read before and after.
review.movesProbe: Read from the multisig's balances before and after it runs: the coin and the tokens it names.
review.lookalike: {{address}} looks like {{label}} ({{known}}): the start and the end match, the address doesn't.
review.toContract: This sends to a contract, {{address}}. Coins sent to a contract that can't move them are lost.
review.blocked: Vela won't sign this transaction: running it would change who controls the multisig.

refusedWhy.delegatecall: Vela won't sign this transaction: it runs another contract's code as the multisig.
refusedWhy.tooDeep: Vela won't sign this transaction: part of it is nested too deep to read, or cut short.
refusedWhy.refund: Vela won't sign this transaction: it pays gas or a refund out of the multisig.
refusedWhy.other: Vela won't sign this transaction: it isn't a kind Vela signs (transfers, calls, member changes, renames and cancellations).

reading.approveAll: Approve every token of a collection
reading.runnerNote: Its calls run from this contract, not from the multisig.
reading.unlimitedLine: Unlimited allowance: {{spender}} could take all of it the multisig holds, now and later.
reading.nestedLine: A batch inside a batch. Every call is listed below; the inner ones run from the batch contract.
reading.unreadableLine: Part of this batch can't be read (nested too deep, or cut short). Vela won't sign it.
reading.decimalsLine: {{token}} didn't say how many decimals it has, so its amounts are shown in base units.
reading.ownTokenLine: This sends tokens to the token's own contract ({{token}}). They'd be lost.
reading.blindLine: Vela can't read what this call does. Approve it only if you know exactly what it is.

state.blocked: Nothing can be signed until it's read.
state.gone: This transaction is no longer in the list.
state.unchecked: Vela couldn't check what this transaction changes.
state.chainUnread: Couldn't reach {{network}} to read this transaction.

review.stateUnconfirmed: Only one node on {{network}} answered, so Vela couldn’t confirm what running it changes in the multisig. Only Vela’s reading of the transaction stands.
review.stateDisagreed: Two independent nodes on {{network}} disagree about what running it changes in the multisig. Only Vela’s reading of the transaction stands.
review.stateOneNode: Only one node could confirm who can act on {{network}} and what running it changes in the multisig. Add your own node in Settings to have it checked twice.
review.blindRefused: Vela won’t sign this here: “Refuse blind signing” is on, and part of this transaction couldn’t be checked. You can change it in Settings.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.on: On. While Vela is closed, this phone checks about every 15 minutes; notifications come from this device, not a push service.
notify.off: Off for Vela, so nothing is said when a transaction needs your approval.
notify.limited: This phone holds back Vela's background checks, so a notification can come late or not at all. Let Vela run in the background in its battery settings.
notify.oem: On some phones (Xiaomi, Huawei, OPPO, vivo and others) the maker's battery saver also holds background checks back. If notifications come late, allow Vela to run in the background without restrictions and to start on its own, in this phone's settings.
